_comment: RBAC matrix for OIDC SSO mode. Single-token mode (no AEO_OIDC_* set) treats token holder as admin. With AEO_OIDC_ISSUER/AUDIENCE/JWKS_URL set, Bearer JWTs are verified (kid-matched JWKS, iss/aud/exp) and the roles claim maps to these permissions.

admin.description: Full control: run analyses, manage uploads/config, read audit, manage users (SCIM stub).

analyst.description: Run analyses, upload data, read results/trends/audit. Cannot change security config or manage users.

viewer.description: Read-only: results, trends, audit, health, security posture. Cannot trigger runs or uploads.

scim.note: Stub with audit event; wire to Entra ID / Okta SCIM provisioning in production.
